newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine casino firm earns 11.2 bln pesos in '96.
newsitem.headline: Philippine casino firm earns 11.2 bln pesos in '96.

text.p: State-owned Philippine Amusement & Gaming Corp (Pagcor) said on Monday it raked in a record 11.2 billion pesos in revenues last year.
The 11.2 billion peso revenues were 19 percent higher than 9.4 billion pesos registered in 1995. It did not give a net income figure for last year.
Pagcor chairman Alicia Reyes said she was expecting a 7.24 percent growth this year for a total revenues of 12.07 billion pesos.
Reyes attributed the growth to its intensified marketing campaign in the neighbouring southeast and east Asian countries.
"Pagcor's marketing sorties in 1996 covered 10 Asian countries from where trial groups of high stake players were brought into the country," Reyes said.
Pagcor operates 12 casinos in the country.
